tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"query": "SELECT source, currency, SUM(market) AS total_market, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM fct_daily_prices
WHERE price_date = '2026-11-10' AND card_name ILIKE '%Umbreon ex%'
GROUP BY source, currency"}

replies.content:
On the latest date (2026-11-10), Umbreon ex has a total market value of **€870.00 on Cardmarket** and **$1,500.00 on TCGplayer** (one variant each).

Note: these are different currencies, so they can't be added into a single combined figure.

sql_run:

FROM fct_daily_prices
WHERE price_date = '2026-11-10' AND card_name ILIKE '%Umbreon ex%'
GROUP BY source, currency
